Definition: from G3844 and G4098; to fall aside, i.e. (figuratively) to apostatize:--fall away.
BiblicalUsage: Parapipto means to fall away, to fall aside. It appears once, in Hebrews 6:6, of those who were once enlightened and then fall away, so that it is impossible to renew them again to repentance, since they crucify the Son of God afresh.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe falling away is not a stumble but a turning, and the warning in Hebrews is meant to keep me from ever making it.
